name: czml-segmented-path
landmark: CZML multi-phase route over Lake Michigan
perspective: regional overhead view showing two CZML material phases
description: Verify that the CesiumJS 1.143 CZML materialMode surface is a time-varying PathMode property by loading one sampled route that switches from PORTIONS to WHOLE while using interval-tagged solid-color materials.
prompt: Create a public no-token Viewer with an explicit OpenStreetMap base layer and EllipsoidTerrainProvider. Define an inline CZML array with a document packet and one route packet. Give the document a clock interval from 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z through 12:04:00Z and currentTime 12:01:00Z. Give the route an epoch-based cartographicDegrees position with five 60-second samples from approximately (-88.0, 41.7, 12000) to (-87.0, 42.0, 12000). Its path must use materialMode as an array of exactly two interval packets: pathMode 'PORTIONS' before 12:02 and pathMode 'WHOLE' from 12:02 onward. Also use resolution: 30, leadTime: 120, trailTime: 120, width: 8, and material as an array of exactly two interval-tagged solidColor packets: cyan before 12:02 and orange from 12:02 onward. Load with await Cesium.CzmlDataSource.load(czml), add the result to viewer.dataSources, set viewer.clock.currentTime to 12:01:00Z with shouldAnimate false, tick once, and frame the full route with Rectangle.fromDegrees(-88.15, 41.55, -86.85, 42.15). Do not reconstruct the route as multiple entities or manual polylines.
expected_behaviors: Defines an inline CZML document and one sampled route packet
Uses epoch-based cartographicDegrees samples over a non-zero interval
Defines CZML path.materialMode as two interval packets that switch from PORTIONS to WHOLE
Defines exactly two interval-tagged solidColor material packets with cyan and orange values
Uses a practical positive resolution and bounded leadTime and trailTime
Loads through CzmlDataSource.load and adds the data source to the Viewer
Positions the clock inside the PORTIONS interval and frames the complete route
Uses one CZML path instead of emulating segmentation with multiple entities
visual_expectations: One continuous route rendered as two plainly distinct CZML-driven portions, cyan and orange, with the entire regional path visible.

programmatic_checks.description: No JS or CZML processing errors
Uses a time-varying CZML PathMode property
Enables segmented rendering in the first interval
Switches to whole-path rendering in the second interval

screenshots.description: CZML path with cyan and orange temporal portions after imagery settles
